description: This file handles the creation and updating of inbound email configurations within SuiteCRM, including saving email account details, managing folder structures, and synchronizing folder subscriptions. It involves retrieving request parameters, validating inputs, creating or updating database records, and managing folder subscriptions and preferences.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class representing a folder in SugarCRM used for organizing email folders, with methods for creation, deletion, and subscription management.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class providing validation methods, such as validating IDs.

methods.name: syncSugarFoldersWithBeanChanges
methods.description: Synchronizes specific fields ('name', 'team_id', 'team_set_id', 'status') of the 'SugarFolder' with the related 'InboundEmail' bean, updating subscriptions or clearing them as needed.
